issues.description: File filter '*.exe' hides conda/mamba executables on macOS and Linux
issues.detail: In confpage.py the browse-file dialog uses filters='*.exe', which only matches Windows executables. On macOS and Linux, conda/mamba/micromamba have no extension, so users will see an empty file picker by default and be unable to select their executable without manually typing a path.

issues.description: validate_conda os.X_OK check fails on Windows
issues.detail: validate_conda rejects paths that fail os.access(path, os.X_OK). On Windows, os.X_OK semantics are unreliable for .exe files and may return False depending on ACLs, causing valid conda.exe paths to be marked invalid. Either drop the X_OK check on Windows or rely solely on the --version probe.

issues.description: Substring match in validate_conda accepts unrelated executables
issues.detail: The check `any(tool in out.decode().lower() for tool in ["micromamba", "mamba", "conda"])` will match any program whose --version output happens to contain 'conda' or 'mamba' (e.g., 'anaconda-project', 'mamba-org tool'). Consider matching against the program basename or a more specific version pattern.

issues.description: Custom conda path is not validated/expanded before being passed to subprocess
issues.detail: In kernelspec.py the value read from get_conf('conda_path') is used directly as conda_exe without expanding ~, normalizing, or re-validating. If the user disables the checkbox after saving an invalid path, or the file was moved, the kernel launch will fail with a confusing error rather than the friendly preferences pointer.

issues.description: Unconditional setFocus() on browse-file edit may surprise other consumers
issues.detail: create_browsefile is shared by many preference panes; adding edit.setFocus() after select_file changes focus behavior for every existing caller, not just the new conda field. Consider gating this on an opt-in parameter to avoid unintended focus changes elsewhere in Preferences.

issues.description: conda_group is added to layout unconditionally even when checkbox is off
issues.detail: The custom conda group is always visible, with only the lineedit enable state toggled. The pyexec group hides similar widgets when the radio is off; consider matching that UX pattern. Minor consistency issue; not blocking.

review.summary: The PR adds a useful preference for a custom conda executable, but the implementation has cross-platform and validation gaps. The browse filter '*.exe' breaks file selection on macOS/Linux, and validate_conda's os.X_OK check plus loose substring matching can both false-reject valid paths and false-accept unrelated binaries. The conda_path is also passed straight to kernel launch without expansion or re-validation. A couple of UX/consistency nits round out the review.
